Bill.BriefDescription: Reauthorizing the joint legislative select committee on health reform implementation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to continuation of the joint legislative selectcommittee on health reform implementation; creating a new section; andproviding an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The joint legislative select committeeon health reform implementation established in section 954, chapter 37,Laws of 2010 is reauthorized. The reauthorized joint legislativeselect committee on health reform implementation shall be cochaired bythe chairs of the health committees of the senate and the house ofrepresentatives, and leadership of the two largest caucuses in thesenate and the house of representatives shall each appoint twoadditional legislators to serve on the committee. (2) The cochairs may direct the continuation of existing advisorygroups and the addition of new groups to focus on specific topic areas,such as insurance regulation, access to and expansion of public andprivate programs, cost containment, and workforce issues. Thecommittee may invite interested stakeholders and additional experts to p. 1 SSB 5508advise the committee. This section expires June 30, 2012.
